programs.title: Ujda Chaman
programs.desc: An astrologer predicts that a 30-year-old bachelor will not marry if he turns 31 and has not married. Thus, the young man is in a race against time to find a suitable bride to marry quickly. Sunny Singh Nijjar, Maanvi Gagroo, Gagan Arora, Karishma Sharma, Atul Kumar, Abhishek Pathak, Raj B Shetty.

programs.title: Cuttputlli
programs.desc: Arjan's investigation into schoolgirl murders and his pursuit of a suspected serial killer leads to a tragic incident involving his niece, resulting in dire consequences. Akshay Kumar, Rakul Preet Singh, Sargun Mehta, Chandrachur Singh, Hrishitaa Bhatt, Ranjit Tiwari, Aseem Arrora.
